correctness.rationale: In characteristic two Q²=0 and linear changes of variables preserve the squarefree ideal. Symplectic normal form reduces Q to sum of r paired products, each with a two-dimensional degree-one homology and contractible (1→uv) pair. Tensor Künneth/contraction yields the universal graded Hilbert series; graded two-strings decompose (1+t)^n and determine the Jordan polynomial. Every product of homology representatives either repeats a variable (zero) or contains p_1⋯p_r=Q p_2⋯p_r (boundary), proving zero multiplication for r>0. The rank-frequency count selects the radical and nondegenerate quotient via |GL|/|Sp|. Independent GF2 linear algebra exhaustively checked 1,098 quadratic forms for n=2..5; arbitrary q,n rely on the proof, not finite checks.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks corroborate only their stated bounded domain; the universal claim depends on reconstructed analytic proof.
